title: Shared definitions for the engine RPC schemas

AbsolutePath.description: An absolute filesystem path in the native format of the host OS. On Windows the engine accepts either path separator.

RequestId.description: The JSON-RPC id of a request.

Stage.description: Stage names reported by convert.progress, in the order a page passes through them. An engine reports only the stages it has.

Warnings.description: Human-readable notes for the log about things that were degraded but not fatal. Not shown to the user.
